title: Use VISU_MDS “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” to copy axis parameters to the selected axis
summary: On the Operator Station HMI (VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen), use the VISU_MDS “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” button to copy Machine Data parameters from the opposite tipper to the selected axis (Z1, A1, Z2, or A2).
when_to_use: Use when you need to update VISU_MDS Machine Data parameters for a selected axis by copying the corresponding parameters from the other tipper using the VISU_MDS “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” function.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for motor replacement commissioning/alignment steps; the manual states Machine Data parameters generally do not require changing unless a motor is replaced.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the VISU_MDS axis selection and press “COPY FROM OPPOSITE”, then verify the Machine Data values updated for the selected axis.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen

access_required: Operator Station HMI access to the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen
system_preconditions: VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen is available and shows axis parameters for Z1, A1, Z2, and A2

visual_references.description: VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen (Figure 4-26) showing axis-specific Machine Data parameters for Z1/A1/Z2/A2 and the “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” button.

steps.title: Open the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen
steps.purpose: Access the screen that contains the axis parameters and the “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” button.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, open the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen (the screen that contains parameters for axes Z1, A1, Z2, and A2).
steps.expected_result: The VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen is displayed with axis parameters visible for Z1, A1, Z2, and A2.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen shows the Machine Data parameter list/table for the axes (including the IDs/fields such as Axis Name, OT Minus, Tote Pickup Position, travel opposite positions, Tote Dump Position, Soft Travel Lim Pos, OT Pos, Base Speed/Acc-Dec for AutoCycle, Jog Speed/Acceleration, and Home/offset/homing parameters).
steps.failure_condition: The VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen does not load, or axis parameter fields are not visible.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_MDS Machine Data
actions.exact_action: Open the Operator Station HMI VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The “Machine Data” screen contains all of the parameters for each axis (Z1, A1, Z2, and A2).

steps.title: Select the target axis (Z1, A1, Z2, or A2)
steps.purpose: Choose which axis’ Machine Data values will be updated by the copy operation.
steps.instruction: On the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen, select the target axis whose parameters you want to update (Z1, A1, Z2, or A2).
steps.expected_result: The selected axis is indicated on the VISU_MDS screen so that the “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” action will apply to that axis.
steps.healthy_condition: The axis selection corresponds to one of the four axes (Z1, A1, Z2, A2) shown on the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen.
steps.failure_condition: No axis is selected, or the selected axis is not one of Z1/A1/Z2/A2.

actions.label: Select target axis
actions.exact_action: Select the target axis on the VISU_MDS screen (one of Z1, A1, Z2, or A2).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: VISU_MDS contains axis parameters for Z1, A1, Z2, and A2.

steps.title: Press “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” to copy parameters to the selected axis
steps.purpose: Copy Machine Data parameters from the other tipper to the selected axis.
steps.instruction: Click the “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” button on the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen.
steps.expected_result: The Machine Data values for the selected axis update to reflect the copied parameters from the opposite tipper.
steps.healthy_condition: After the button press, the selected axis’ Machine Data values change from their prior values to match the copied set (for the parameters that are intended to match machine-to-machine).
steps.failure_condition: Pressing “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” results in no visible change to the selected axis Machine Data values.

actions.label: Copy from opposite tipper
actions.exact_action: Click the “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” button to copy parameters to the selected axis from the other tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” results in no visible change to the selected axis Machine Data values, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Use the COPY FROM OPPOSITE button to copy parameters to the selected axis from the other tipper.

steps.title: Verify the selected axis Machine Data values updated
steps.purpose: Confirm the copy operation updated the expected Machine Data IDs/fields for the selected axis.
steps.instruction: On the VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen, verify that the Machine Data values for the selected axis updated to the copied values. Check the listed IDs/fields including: OT Minus (ID 1), Tote Pickup Position (ID 5), travel opposite positions (IDs 6 and 7), Tote Dump Position (ID 8), Soft Travel Lim Pos (ID 9), OT Pos (ID 10), Base Speed for AutoCycle (ID 11) and Base Acc/Dec for AutoCycle (ID 12), Jog Speed (ID 13) and Jog Acceleration (ID 14), and Home/offset/homing parameters (IDs 20–24).
steps.expected_result: The selected axis shows updated values for the checked Machine Data IDs/fields after the copy.
steps.healthy_condition: The Machine Data values for the selected axis reflect the copied parameters from the other tipper for the parameters that should match machine-to-machine (with the manual-stated exceptions).
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the checked Machine Data IDs/fields do not change as expected after the copy, or mismatches persist after copy.

actions.label: Check Machine Data IDs/fields
actions.exact_action: Verify on the VISU_MDS screen that the Machine Data values for the selected axis updated to the copied values (check the listed IDs/fields such as OT Minus (ID 1), Tote Pickup Position (ID 5), travel opposite positions (IDs 6 and 7), Tote Dump Position (ID 8), Soft Travel Lim Pos (ID 9), OT Pos (ID 10), Base Speed/Acc-Dec for AutoCycle (IDs 11–12), Jog Speed/Acceleration (IDs 13–14), and Home/offset/homing parameters (IDs 20–24)).

stop_or_escalate_if: If mismatches persist after copy, re-check the axis selection and the specific Machine Data IDs shown on VISU_MDS.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: From machine to machine, the following data values should match: ID 1 OT Minus; ID 5 Tote Pickup Position; ID 6 Plus Travel Opposite Axis Position; ID 7 Neg Travel Opposite Axis Position; ID 8 Tote Dump Position; ID 9 Soft Travel Lim Pos; ID 10 OT Pos; ID 11 Base Speed for AutoCycle; ID 12 Base Acc/Dec for AutoCycle; ID 13 Jog Speed; ID 14 Jog Acceleration; and ID 20 Home Position; ID 21 Home Offset; ID 22 Homing Speed; ID 23 Homing CAM Speed; ID 24 Homing Acceleration.
Exceptions for matching values: MD5 Tote Pickup Position will be unique for every machine and every axis; MD21 Home Offset will be unique for every machine and every axis.

success_criteria: After pressing “COPY FROM OPPOSITE”, the VISU_MDS Machine Data values for the selected axis reflect the copied parameters from the opposite tipper.

The checked Machine Data IDs/fields on VISU_MDS show updated values consistent with the manual’s machine-to-machine matching list, accounting for the stated exceptions (MD5 Tote Pickup Position and MD21 Home Offset).
healthy_conditions: VISU_MDS “Machine Data” screen shows axis parameters for Z1, A1, Z2, and A2.
After “COPY FROM OPPOSITE”, the selected axis Machine Data values update (for the parameters intended to match machine-to-machine).
MD5 Tote Pickup Position and MD21 Home Offset are treated as exceptions (unique per machine and axis) when evaluating whether values match.
failure_conditions: Pressing “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” produces no visible change to the selected axis Machine Data values.
After copy, one or more expected Machine Data IDs/fields do not update or remain mismatched (excluding the manual-stated exceptions).
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if pressing “COPY FROM OPPOSITE” results in no visible change to the selected axis Machine Data values.
If mismatches persist after copy, re-check the axis selection and the specific Machine Data IDs shown on VISU_MDS, then escalate if still unresolved.
